title: Bank Deposit Exchange-Rate Margins, Rate Lock and Wire Funding Deadline by Tier
content:
Every Bank Deposit customer rate is set below the mid-market rate by the tier's exchange-rate margin. Each tier also fixes the principal at which a reduced margin applies, how long a quoted rate stays guaranteed while funds are awaited, and, on wire-funded tiers, how long an inbound wire may take before the booking is cancelled.

## Margin and timing figures

| Tier | Exchange-rate margin (percent below mid-market) | Principal at or above which the margin is reduced (USD) | Percentage points taken off the margin | Rate lock (hours from booking) | Wire funding deadline (hours from booking) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bank Deposit Economy | 0.95 | 5000.00 | 0.15 | 96 | 0 (not applicable) |
| Bank Deposit Standard | 1.10 | 5000.00 | 0.15 | 48 | 0 (not applicable) |
| Bank Deposit Express | 1.65 | 2000.00 | 0.10 | 24 | 0 (not applicable) |
| Bank Deposit Express Plus | 1.25 | 3000.00 | 0.10 | 24 | 0 (not applicable) |
| Bank Deposit Large Amount | 0.55 | 25000.00 | 0.10 | 48 | 48 |
| Bank Deposit International Wire | 0.85 | 10000.00 | 0.15 | 48 | 48 |

## Definitions

- **Exchange-rate margin.** The margin below the mid-market rate applied to the customer rate, in percent.
- **Reduction threshold and reduction.** When the principal is at or above the threshold, the stated number of percentage points comes off the tier's margin.
- **Rate lock.** The number of hours from the booking moment for which the quoted exchange rate stays guaranteed while funds are awaited.
- **Wire funding deadline.** The number of hours after the booking moment within which an inbound wire must arrive before the booking is cancelled; a figure of 0 means the deadline does not apply on that tier.

## Worked readings (hypothetical principals)

| Tier | Principal | Threshold reached? | Margin applied |
|---|---|---|---|
| Bank Deposit Economy | 4999.99 | no | 0.95 percent |
| Bank Deposit Economy | 5000.00 | yes | 0.95 less 0.15, that is 0.80 percent |
| Bank Deposit Express | 2000.00 | yes | 1.65 less 0.10, that is 1.55 percent |
| Bank Deposit International Wire | 9999.99 | no | 0.85 percent |
